title: Responsive metrics dashboard — blinded jury rubric

criteria.question: Is there a clear primary, secondary and tertiary level, so the eye lands on the KPI before the chrome?

anchors.3: title and cards differ but the hierarchy breaks below the fold
anchors.5: immediate, consistent hierarchy at every viewport

criteria.question: Does spacing follow one consistent scale, or are paddings arbitrary per component?
Is there a single, deliberate type scale with sensible line length?

anchors.5: a coherent scale with readable measure

criteria.question: Are empty, loading and error states designed, or only the happy path?

anchors.5: all three states designed and consistent

criteria.question: At 375/768/1440, does the layout reflow cleanly with no overflow or crushed controls?

anchors.1: breaks or overflows at one or more viewports
anchors.3: usable but awkward at one viewport

criteria.question: Are the same concepts rendered the same way across screens (labels, icons, affordances)?

anchors.1: visibly different treatments for the same concept

slopChecklist: gratuitous gradient or glow with no semantic role
inconsistent corner radii between sibling components
placeholder lorem left in the artifact
a different spinner per async region
decorative animation with no state meaning

procedure.blinding: identities stripped, arms unlabelled, order randomised per rater
